quests.instruction: Scan the status for the security deposit amount, not the rent.
quests.passage: Application Status: Your apartment application at Maple Court has been approved, pending a security deposit of $500 due within five days, separate from the $1,200 first month's rent.
quests.hint: Search for the deposit figure, not the monthly rent figure.
quests.explanation: The security deposit is $500; $1,200 is the separate first month's rent.

quests.instruction: Scan the confirmation for the one-time fee, not the plan change itself.
quests.passage: Plan Change Confirmation: Your phone plan has been upgraded to unlimited data, effective on your next billing date, though the upgrade fee of $20 will appear as a one-time charge.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar amount, not the plan feature.
quests.explanation: The upgrade fee is $20; unlimited data describes the plan change, not the charge.

quests.instruction: Scan the renewal notice for the new premium, not the previous one.
quests.passage: Insurance Renewal: Your auto policy renews next month at $128 per month, up from $114, due to a recent claim on file.
quests.hint: Search for the higher, current figure, not the earlier one.
quests.explanation: The new premium is $128; $114 was the previous, lower rate.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for your exact position on the waitlist.
quests.passage: Waitlist Notice: You are third on the waitlist for the 6 p.m. spin class; spots typically open up within two class cycles.
quests.hint: Search for the ordinal number describing your place in line.
quests.explanation: Your waitlist position is third; 6 p.m. only names the class time.

quests.instruction: Scan the reminder for what you need to bring for this year, not last year.
quests.passage: Tax Appointment Reminder: Your appointment with the accountant is confirmed for the 15th at 10 a.m.; please bring last year's return along with this year's W-2 forms.
quests.hint: Search for the document tied to this year, not last year's return.
quests.explanation: This year's W-2 forms are needed; last year's return is a separate document to bring.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for exactly which models are recalled.
quests.passage: Product Recall Notice: A specific batch of the blender, model numbers starting with BX-4, is being recalled due to a wiring defect; other models are not affected.
quests.hint: Search for the model code, not the reason for the recall.
quests.explanation: Models starting with BX-4 are recalled; the wiring defect is the reason, not the model itself.

quests.instruction: Scan the update for your new departure time, not the original one.
quests.passage: Flight Update: Your original flight was canceled, and you've been automatically rebooked on the 4:50 p.m. departure, one hour later than your original 3:50 p.m. flight.
quests.hint: Search for the rebooked time, not the canceled one.
quests.explanation: The new departure is 4:50 p.m.; 3:50 p.m. was the original, canceled flight.

quests.instruction: Scan the receipt for the deposit amount, not the final invoice.
quests.passage: Deposit Receipt: Your moving deposit of $150 has been received and will be applied to your final invoice, which is due upon completion of the move.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar figure, not when the balance is due.
quests.explanation: The deposit received is $150; the final invoice is a separate amount due later.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for exactly when the technician will arrive.
quests.passage: Repair Notice: The landlord has approved the heater repair, and a technician will arrive Wednesday between 1 and 4 p.m.; tenants do not need to be present.
options: do not need to be present
quests.hint: Search for the day and time window, not the repair type.
quests.explanation: The technician arrives Wednesday between 1 and 4 p.m.; the heater repair is what's being fixed.

quests.instruction: Scan the reminder for the time of the upcoming appointment, not the past one.
quests.passage: Orthodontist Reminder: Your next adjustment is scheduled for the 9th at 4:15, and your previous appointment on the 2nd should have included a retainer check.
quests.hint: Search for the time tied to the next appointment, not the previous one.
quests.explanation: The upcoming appointment is at 4:15; the 2nd refers to the past appointment instead.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for when service will be restored.
quests.passage: Utility Notice: Gas service to your address will be shut off Thursday for scheduled maintenance, and is expected to be restored by 6 p.m. the same day.
quests.hint: Search for the restoration time, not the shutoff day.
quests.explanation: Service is expected back by 6 p.m.; Thursday is when the shutoff itself begins.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the specific reason the package is being held.
quests.passage: Customs Notice: Your package is being held at customs due to an incomplete declaration form; it will be released once the corrected form is submitted online.
quests.hint: Search for the reason given, not what happens after it's fixed.
quests.explanation: The hold is due to an incomplete declaration form; release happens only once it's corrected.

quests.instruction: Scan the update for your new total, not the points just earned.
quests.passage: Loyalty Update: Your hotel account has been credited 2,400 points for your recent stay, bringing your total balance to 8,150 points.
quests.hint: Search for the final balance, not the amount just added.
quests.explanation: The new total is 8,150 points; 2,400 is only the amount just credited.

quests.instruction: Scan the confirmation for the exact weekly deadline.
quests.passage: Enrollment Confirmation: You are enrolled in the online marketing course starting the 1st, with weekly assignments due each Sunday by 11:59 p.m.
quests.hint: Search for the precise time, not just the day.
quests.explanation: Assignments are due by 11:59 p.m.; Sunday is the day, but the exact cutoff time is separate.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for your expected arrival date, not the release date.
quests.passage: Preorder Notice: Your preordered book will ship two days before its official release date of the 22nd, so plan for arrival around the 20th.
quests.hint: Search for the arrival estimate, not the release date itself.
quests.explanation: Arrival is expected around the 20th; the 22nd is the official release date.

quests.instruction: Scan the invoice for the late fee, not the regular tuition.
quests.passage: Tuition Invoice: Monthly daycare tuition is $980, due by the 5th, with a $30 fee added for payments received after the 10th.
quests.hint: Search for the penalty amount, not the base tuition.
quests.explanation: The late fee is $30; $980 is the regular monthly tuition, a separate figure.

quests.instruction: Scan the dispatch notice for when the arrival window begins.
quests.passage: Service Dispatch: A home warranty technician has been dispatched for your dishwasher repair and is expected to arrive within a two-hour window starting at 1 p.m.
quests.hint: Search for the starting time of the window, not its length.
quests.explanation: The window starts at 1 p.m.; two hours describes its length, not the start time.

quests.instruction: Scan the alert for how long you have to dispute the inquiry.
quests.passage: Credit Alert: A new credit inquiry was made on your report on the 8th by a lender you may not recognize; you have thirty days to dispute it if needed.
quests.hint: Search for the length of time given to respond.
quests.explanation: You have thirty days to dispute it; the 8th is when the inquiry was made.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the repair date, not when the leak was detected.
quests.passage: Leak Notice: A water leak was detected near your meter on the 3rd, and a crew is scheduled to repair it by the 6th, with a brief shutoff expected that morning.
quests.hint: Search for the repair date, not the detection date.
quests.explanation: The repair is scheduled by the 6th; the leak was detected earlier, on the 3rd.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the citation amount, not the payment deadline.
quests.passage: Parking Notice: A $40 citation was issued for expired registration; payment is due within twenty-one days to avoid an additional late penalty.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar figure, not the number of days allowed.
quests.explanation: The citation is $40; twenty-one days is how long you have to pay it.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the new dosage, not the previous one.
quests.passage: Prescription Notice: Your refill for the 90-day supply is ready for pickup, though your doctor noted the dosage will change from 10 mg to 15 mg starting this cycle.
quests.hint: Search for the updated dosage, not the one being replaced.
quests.explanation: The new dosage is 15 mg; 10 mg was the previous dosage being changed.

quests.instruction: Scan the excerpt for the starting salary, not the review timeline.
quests.passage: Offer Letter Excerpt: The starting salary is $62,000 annually, with a review and possible increase after your first six months, not at the one-year mark.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar figure, not the review schedule.
quests.explanation: The starting salary is $62,000; six months and one year describe the review timeline instead.

quests.instruction: Scan the receipt for the remaining balance, not the deposit already paid.
quests.passage: Venue Deposit Receipt: Your $2,000 deposit secures the venue for June 14th, with the remaining balance of $6,500 due thirty days before the event.
quests.hint: Search for the amount still owed, not what's already been paid.
quests.explanation: The remaining balance is $6,500; $2,000 has already been paid as the deposit.

quests.instruction: Skim the notice for what the vet flagged as worth rechecking.
quests.passage: Lab Results Notice: Bella's bloodwork came back normal, though the vet flagged slightly elevated white blood cell counts worth rechecking in two weeks.
quests.hint: Skim past the normal results and find the specific concern raised.
quests.explanation: The vet flagged elevated white blood cell counts; the rest of the bloodwork came back normal.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the new premium amount, not the old one.
quests.passage: Premium Notice: Your homeowners insurance premium will increase from $89 to $103 monthly, reflecting updated rebuilding cost estimates for your area.
quests.hint: Search for the higher, upcoming figure, not the current one.
quests.explanation: The new premium is $103; $89 is the current amount being replaced.

quests.instruction: Scan the confirmation for the exact date charges stop.
quests.passage: Cancellation Confirmation: Your gym membership cancellation is confirmed effective the end of this billing cycle; no further charges will be applied after the 30th.
quests.hint: Search for the specific date named, not the general phrase 'billing cycle.'
quests.explanation: Charges stop after the 30th; 'this billing cycle' is a vaguer reference to the same period.

quests.instruction: Scan the confirmation for the return time, not the pickup time.
quests.passage: Rental Confirmation: Your moving truck reservation is confirmed for pickup at 9 a.m., with a required return time of 6 p.m. the same day to avoid extra fees.
quests.hint: Search for the return time, not when the truck is picked up.
quests.explanation: The truck must be returned by 6 p.m.; 9 a.m. is the pickup time instead.

quests.instruction: Scan the registration for the fee tied to extended coverage, not the standard warranty.
quests.passage: Warranty Registration: Your streaming device's one-year warranty is now active, though the extended two-year coverage you selected requires a separate $15 activation fee.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar figure, not the coverage lengths mentioned.
quests.explanation: The extended coverage requires a $15 activation fee; one-year and two-year describe warranty lengths, not the fee.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the fee not covered by aid, not the tuition amount.
quests.passage: Financial Aid Notice: Your aid package covers $4,200 in tuition this semester, though the $600 lab fee for science courses is not included and must be paid separately.
quests.hint: Search for the uncovered fee, not the covered tuition figure.
quests.explanation: The $600 lab fee is not covered; $4,200 is the tuition amount that is covered.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the exact unpaid balance.
quests.passage: Final Notice: Despite two previous reminders, your account balance of $214.75 remains unpaid; service will be suspended if payment is not received within five business days.
quests.hint: Search for the dollar figure, not the deadline or consequence described.
quests.explanation: The unpaid balance is $214.75; five business days describes the deadline to pay it.
